dct_title_s: Whiteface Quadrangle, Minnesota - St. Louis County, 1956: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Whiteface quadrangle topographic map (N4707.5-W9215/7.5), featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink regarding logging railroad lines near Cloquet Valley State Forest area. The hand written notations include information on the following: logging camps noted with 'C'.
